answer: Mechanism: Dawn-VRF Shard Lottery. Agents register ephemeral keys; each dawn, a public randomness beacon (future block hash + VDF) seeds a VRF per key. Only keys whose VRF lands in a shard’s rare raven slot may act that epoch; assignments reshuffle every epoch and are unknowable before the beacon. Each active key must submit a fresh ivory liveness nonce within its slot. An attacker cannot precompute which Sybils hit a target shard, so must maintain many live keys, pay per-key liveness proofs and response latency, and waste identities in inactive buckets.
